description: Conservative standard Unicode and Zawgyi detection cases using the Google Myanmar Tools model.
derivation: Strong, ambiguous, digit-only, and non-Burmese-language examples are selected from the Apache-2.0 Google Myanmar Tools compatibility fixtures. Mixed-input and offset cases exercise the project-authored wrapper behavior.

cases.basis: Non-Myanmar text is outside encoding detection.

cases.basis: Google Myanmar Tools publishes this as its strong Unicode behavior example.

cases.basis: The upstream compatibility score is near one half, so the conservative profile does not guess.

Shared Myanmar punctuation does not cross either conservative probability threshold.
